instructions.pick_place: Use your right hand to pick up the block, place it inside the target circle on the left, and release it.
instructions.stack: Use your right hand to stack the upper block on top of the other block, then release it.
instructions.piano: Use your right hand to press and release the piano keys in this order: 5, 5, 6, 6, 7, 7, 6, 4. Key indices are zero-based, from Key_0 to Key_7.
instructions.gesture_one: Make the number-one hand gesture with your right hand and hold it.
instructions.gesture_two: Make the number-two hand gesture with your right hand and hold it.
instructions.produce_sort: Use your right hand to place the orange and the bell pepper into their respective designated sorting bowls, then release them.
instructions.microwave_open: Use the four fingers of your left hand to hook around the microwave handle and pull the door open.

notes: Piano order explicitly added from verified evaluation code; indices are not musical pitch names.
